rows.jp: 最古の記憶は。
rows.en: My earliest memory—

ghs.en:
These are the recollections
of that which is so far gone.
ghs.assessment: 最古 marks the earliest or oldest memory. The rendering replaces the superlative with mere remoteness, changes a singular fragment into plural recollections, and supplies an object not present in the Japanese.
ghs.remedy: Retain the singular earliest-memory fragment and its superlative force.

highlights.text:
These are the recollections
of that which is so far gone.

rows.jp: 日付さえおぼろげな、遠い霞のなか。
rows.en: Far away in a haze, its very date indistinct.

ghs.en:
The date alone vague and indistinct,
laying at the heart of a dim distant haze.
ghs.assessment: さえ is scalar and additive: even the date is hazy. 'The date alone' instead suggests that only the date is vague. 'At the heart of' is added, and 'laying' is ungrammatical in this intransitive construction.
ghs.remedy: Express that even the date is vague within a distant haze, without the added center metaphor.

highlights.text:
The date alone vague and indistinct,

rows.jp: 貴族的な気品を抱く、豪華な私室。
rows.en: A lavish private chamber, steeped in aristocratic elegance.

ghs.en:
A grandiose bedroom,
draped in aristocratic grace.

rows.jp: そこには天蓋つきの寝台も欧羅巴製の椅子もあった。
rows.en: It held a canopied bed and chairs imported from Europe.

ghs.en:
Inside there were a canopied bed
and a chair of European make.

rows.jp: けど床に座るのが一番好きだった。
rows.en: But I liked sitting on the floor best.

ghs.en:
But sitting on the floor was always
what I preferred.

rows.jp: こんな日は特に。
rows.en: Especially on a day like that.

ghs.en: Especially on days like this.

rows.jp: 窓から見える黒の帳は星月夜。
rows.en: Beyond the window, the black curtain of a starry night.

ghs.en:
The starry heavens are a dark
curtain visible from the window,

rows.jp: 枠に切り取られた散在する瞬きに目を奪われる。
rows.en: The scattered glimmers framed there held my gaze.

ghs.en:
a scattering of twinkles cut off by
the frame that absconds with my sight.
ghs.assessment: The scattered glints, cut out by the frame, capture the observer's gaze. The English instead makes the frame the agent that 'absconds' with sight, changing the source's attachment and using an inapplicable English verb.
ghs.remedy: Make the framed, scattered glints the object that captures the gaze.

highlights.text:
a scattering of twinkles cut off by
the frame that absconds with my sight.

rows.jp: 外界と室内を隔てる窓ガラスに、己の姿が映る。
rows.en: The windowpane, dividing this room from the world outside, reflected my own form.

ghs.en:
In the glass that segregates the outside
world from the interior of the room,
the reflection of my shape.

rows.jp: 深窓の令嬢―――
rows.en: A sheltered young lady—

ghs.en: A young lady kept secluded from the world---

rows.jp: 洋風のドレスに身を包む、楚々とした少女。
rows.en: A demure girl in a Western dress.

ghs.en:
A maiden with the appearance of grace,
the skin clothed in a Western dress.

rows.jp: きみはいったい、だれですか？
rows.en: Who, then, are you?

ghs.en: You... who could you possibly be?

rows.en: “...Taichi.”

ghs.en: Girl: "...Taichi."

rows.jp: 透けて輪郭をぼかす……銀髪。
rows.en: Silver hair, nearly translucent, blurring the figure's outline...

ghs.en: A transparent outline shaded off... by silver hair.

rows.jp: 長くしだれて腰を包む、その先端はゆるやかに波打つ。
rows.en: It fell long around the waist, its ends rippling in gentle waves.

ghs.en: A length that hangs down to surround the waist, its tips undulating loosely.

rows.jp: 顔は小さい。まるで人形の頭身だ。
rows.en: The face was small. The proportions were those of a doll.

ghs.en: The face is tiny. A body and a head just as if a doll.

rows.jp: 『浮世離れしたお顔立ちね』
rows.en: ‘Such an unworldly face.’

ghs.en: 『Otherworldly looks.』

rows.jp: 誰だろう、そんなことを言ったのは。
rows.en: Who had said that?

ghs.en: Who was it, even, that said that.

rows.jp: 奥様だったか、上の姉君だったか。
rows.en: The lady of the house, perhaps, or one of the elder daughters.

ghs.en: Maybe it was one of the madams, maybe it was one of the higher ranking sisters.

rows.jp: あまやかな声が耳にゆかしい。
rows.en: The sweet voice pleased the ear.

ghs.en: A voice of sweetness that enchants the ears.

rows.jp: 誕生して十年に満たない頃の記憶は、どこか混濁して夢心地だ。
rows.en: My memories from before I was ten are muddled, almost dreamlike.

ghs.en: The memories of the time that came before ten years had passed after my birth are in many ways a muddied trance-like dream.

rows.jp: 『こっちにおいでなさい、遊びましょう』
rows.en: ‘Come here. Let us play.’

ghs.en: 『Come over here now, let's play.』

rows.jp: 逆らったことはなかった。
rows.en: I never resisted.

ghs.en: No volition of opposition.

rows.jp: 少女の服、少女のマナー、少女の言葉遣い。
rows.en: A girl's clothes. A girl's manners. A girl's way of speaking.

ghs.en: The clothes of a girl, the mannerisms of a girl, the verbal affectations of a girl.

rows.jp: 屋敷に働く者たちとその優雅な主たちの、高尚とも幼稚ともつかないお人形さん遊びは、退屈ではあったが不快ではなかった。
rows.en: The servants and their elegant mistresses played at dolls with me, in a game too refined to be childish and too childish to be refined. It bored me, but did not offend me.

ghs.en: The ones that work at the estate as well as the elegantly refined lords who reside in it held the possibly noble, possibly childish hobby of playing with human dolls, which to me held tedium but not unpleasantness.

rows.jp: そのような理由だったと思う。
rows.en: I believe that was why.

ghs.en: I think that could be said to be the reason, in the end,

rows.jp: 窓枠に映し出される自分の姿が、いつも少女そのものだったのは。
rows.en: Why the self reflected in the window was always, entirely, a girl.

ghs.en: for why the reflection of my figure on the window frame was always that of a girl.

rows.jp: そう、ただ一つ記憶していることがある。明確に。
rows.en: Yes. There is one thing I remember with perfect clarity.

ghs.en: Yes, there is merely one single thing that I recall. Clearly, I mean.

rows.jp: 大勢の年端もいかない少女たちの中、ひとりだけ笑わない子がいた。
rows.en: Among the crowd of very young girls, there was one child who never smiled.

ghs.en: Among the many girls of tender and young age, there was only one that did not smile.

rows.jp: 彼女だけは、ぼくで遊ぶことはなかった。
rows.en: She alone never played with me.

ghs.en: She, alone, never once played with me.

rows.jp: 少女の格好で茶の相手をつとめる『ぼく』の姿は、いつも赤裸々に飾られていて。
rows.en: The sight of ‘me’ dressed as a girl and serving tea was always shamelessly displayed as ornament.

ghs.en: The outwards of a girl that services as a member of the tea party, the forms of the "me" that was yet young and manly, always were displayed in frankness.

rows.jp: 広い庭をひとりで散策する彼女は、ちらと軽蔑するかのような仕草で目線をよこすのだった。
rows.en: As she walked alone through the vast garden, she would cast me one sidelong glance, almost contemptuous in its bearing.

ghs.en: The girl that strolls alone in the vast garden sent me a gesture as if possibly of scorn, casually, via a flicker of a gaze.

rows.jp: 黒曜石を思わせる澄んだ墨色の瞳で。
rows.en: From clear, ink-dark eyes like obsidian.

ghs.en: With eyes of a clear black that reminds of obsidian.

rows.jp: 動揺。
rows.en: Disquiet.

ghs.en: Discomposure.

rows.jp: 視線を向けられると、いつも心はパニックになった。
rows.en: Whenever she looked my way, my heart went into a panic.

ghs.en: Whenever my gaze turns her way, my heart turned to panic.

rows.jp: 歓喜か、羞恥か。
rows.en: Joy, or shame?

ghs.en: Delight perhaps, shyness perhaps.

rows.jp: あるいは両方か。
rows.en: Or both?

ghs.en: Perhaps both, perhaps.

rows.jp: おおよそ動じた経験のないぼくにとって、制御できない情動の暴走は希有だ。
rows.en: I had scarcely ever been shaken by anything. An uncontrollable riot of feeling was rare.

ghs.en: To me, who had almost never experienced agitation, runaway emotions, impossible to control, are uncommon.

rows.jp: それでも表向きは、平然とご婦人たちに笑顔をふりまく。
rows.en: Outwardly, however, I serenely scattered smiles among the ladies.

ghs.en: And still, outwardly, I lavished the ladies with serene smiles.

rows.jp: わきまえるべきは自分の役目だ。
rows.en: I knew the role expected of me.

ghs.en: I am expected to understand my role.

rows.jp: 役目……人形に徹すること。
rows.en: My role... to be a perfect doll.

ghs.en: My role... was to devotedly be a doll.

rows.jp: 生きるために。
rows.en: In order to live.

ghs.en: For the sake of living.

rows.jp: その人形時代、彼女と会話することはなかった。
rows.en: During those days as a doll, I never spoke with her.

ghs.en: In that doll era there never was a conversation with her.

rows.jp: ただの一度も。
rows.en: Not once.

ghs.en: Not even once.

rows.jp: へだてた場所に超然と立つ少女の姿だけは、つよく印象に残った。
rows.en: Yet only the sight of the girl standing aloof some distance away stayed etched in my mind.

ghs.en: The figure of a girl standing detached, in an isolated location, left behind a strong impression.

rows.jp: 後に知った。
rows.en: I learned later—

ghs.en: I learned, afterwards,

rows.jp: 彼女もまた金にあかせて買い取られた、人形だったのだと。
rows.en: that she, too, was a doll they had bought without regard for the expense.

ghs.en: the she was bought, sparing no expense, and she was also a doll.

rows.jp: ひやり、と空気が渦巻く。
rows.en: A cold current swirls through the air.

ghs.en: With alarming chill, the mood swirled into an eddy.

rows.jp: 冷えた廊下の外気だ。
rows.en: The chill air of the corridor.

ghs.en: The open air of the corridor had frozen.

rows.jp: 振り返ると、音もなく開いた扉の横。
rows.en: I turn. Beside the door that opened without a sound—

ghs.en: I turned around and, right next to a door that had opened without a sound,

rows.jp: 彼女が立っていた。
rows.en: she stands.

ghs.en: there she stood.

rows.jp: 孤高の君―――
rows.en: My proud, solitary lady—

ghs.en: You who stand above---

rows.jp: だけどどうしたことか。
rows.en: And yet, what has happened?

ghs.en: And yet, what has she been doing?

rows.jp: 目の前に立つ少女は、薄汚れていた。
rows.en: The girl before me is grimy.

ghs.en: The girl standing in front of my eyes was dirty all over.

rows.jp: 違う。
rows.en: No.

ghs.en: No,

rows.jp: 汚されていた。悪辣な手段で。
rows.en: She has been defiled. By vicious means.

ghs.en: she had been filthied. And in ways unscrupulous and vicious.

rows.jp: 裂けた衣服。白い肌を走る擦過傷。
rows.en: Torn clothes. Abrasions running across white skin.

ghs.en: Her clothes torn. Her white skin ran all over by scratches and abrasions.

rows.jp: 唇の端には黒ずんだ血の筋。
rows.en: A dark trail of blood at the corner of her mouth.

ghs.en: Next to the lip, a darkening streak of blood.

rows.jp: ぐらり
rows.en: Lurch.

ghs.en: Violent shaking.

rows.jp: 視界が波打つ。
rows.en: My vision ripples.

ghs.en: Vision undulating.

rows.jp: 滑稽ではあったが幸福だった人形時代。
rows.en: My days as a doll, absurd but happy.

ghs.en: In the era of the doll, full of ridiculousness but also of happiness,

rows.jp: ぼくと彼女が、同居したことはない。
rows.en: She and I never lived together then.

ghs.en: there was no coexistence between me and her.

rows.jp: 記憶が混乱している。
rows.en: My memories are confused.

ghs.en: Memories are confusing and disordering.

rows.jp: そう……つまり……彼女がここにいるということは……。
rows.en: Yes... which means... if she is here...

ghs.en: Yes... in other words... for the individual she is began to be here, that means...

rows.jp: かしましい奥様とご令嬢。うら若い使用人たち。
rows.en: The clamorous lady and daughters of the house. The young servants.

ghs.en: The noisy wives and young ladies, the youthful servants...

rows.jp: 砂糖菓子のように甘い日々は、記憶の中で早回しに過ぎ去る。
rows.en: Those candy-sweet days race through my memory in fast-forward.

ghs.en: In my recollections, those days as sweet as confectionery are already speeding up and passing.

rows.jp: すべての景色は色彩を失い、くすんだ灰色へと劣化していく。
rows.en: Every scene loses its color, decaying into a tarnished gray.

ghs.en: All the scenery loses its tint, deteriorating to a dull ash gray.

rows.jp: 彼女が扉をあけて部屋にやってくる時代。
rows.en: The age in which she opens the door and enters our room.

ghs.en: This is the era where she opens the door and comes inside the room.

rows.jp: それは人形時代ではない。
rows.en: Not my days as a doll.

ghs.en: That is not the era of the doll,

rows.jp: もっと後……。
rows.en: Later...

ghs.en: it's much later...

rows.jp: ぼくらふたりに、たった一部屋しかあてがわれない時代。
rows.en: The age in which the two of us are allotted only a single room.

ghs.en: This is the era where me and her were given nothing but one single room.

rows.jp: 舞台は天国から地獄へ。
rows.en: The stage shifts from heaven to hell.

ghs.en: The stage moves from heaven to hell.

rows.jp: 気がつけば、辺りの調度は失せて灰色の壁にとってかわる。
rows.en: When I come to myself, the furnishings are gone, replaced by gray walls.

ghs.en: As I notice, the furniture surrounding me had been removed and supplanted by a featureless gray wall.

rows.jp: 寝台は粗末に。
rows.en: A shabby bed.

ghs.en: A plain bed,

rows.jp: シーツは薄汚れ。
rows.en: Dingy sheets.

ghs.en: sheets just somewhat filthy,

rows.jp: 照明は裸電球。
rows.en: A bare lightbulb.

ghs.en: a bare bulb for light,

rows.jp: 床はささくれた板張り。
rows.en: Splintered floorboards.

ghs.en: a floor of splintering wood.

rows.jp: 美しいシルクのカーテンは、雑巾も同然の身分へと下った。
rows.en: The beautiful silk curtains have fallen to the station of rags.

ghs.en: The beautiful silk curtains hang down like house rags, as fallen as our social position.

rows.jp: つらく、重く、卑劣で、早すぎた人生の隘路(あいろ)。
rows.en: A hard, heavy, sordid strait in life, reached far too soon.

ghs.en: The heartbreaking, gloomy, cowardly bottlenecking of a life still at its early stages.

rows.jp: その境遇が口もきかなかったふたりを束ねた。
rows.en: That circumstance bound together two children who had never even spoken.

ghs.en: Those circumstances bundled two together who had never really spoken.

rows.jp: 「太一」
rows.en: “Taichi.”

ghs.en: Girl: "Taichi."

rows.jp: ぼくの名だ。
rows.en: My name.

ghs.en: A young male's name, mine.

rows.jp: 奥様たちは、この男らしい名前から一文字を取り、かわりに女の子そのものの一文字を付け加えた名でぼくを呼んでいた。
rows.en: The ladies kept the 一 (ichi) in my masculine name, 太一 (Taichi), and replaced the other character with 姫 (hime)—‘girl’ or ‘princess’—to give me a new name.

ghs.en: The ladies took the 'ta' kanji away from my too manly name, kept the 'ichi', and added one very female kanji at the end in exchange to make the name they called me with:

rows.jp: 一姫。
rows.en: 一姫—Ichihime.

ghs.en: Ichiko. One-princess.

rows.jp: 風雅ではある。
rows.en: It had a certain elegance.

ghs.en: It is elegantly refined.

rows.jp: ただ彼女が、ぼくをそう呼んだことはない。
rows.en: But she never called me that.

ghs.en: She alone has never called me with that name, not once.

rows.jp: 「なにか、飲む？」
rows.en: “Would you like something to drink?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Want to drink something?"

rows.jp: 問いかけにも反応せず、彼女はぼくとの距離を詰めた。
rows.en: She makes no response to the question, only closes the distance between us.

ghs.en: Without answering the asked question she shortened the distance between herself and me.

rows.jp: そしてごく自然に、寝台に押し倒してきた。
rows.en: Then, as naturally as could be, she pushes me down onto the bed.

ghs.en: And then, very naturally, pushed me down on the bed.
Girl: "..."

rows.jp: 触れるほどに近い。
rows.en: So close we nearly touch.

ghs.en: Touching closer and closer.

rows.jp: 隙間には、沈黙が漂う。
rows.en: Silence hangs in the narrow space between us.

ghs.en: In the gap, silence floats,

rows.jp: 呼吸が止まりそうになる。
rows.en: My breath almost stops.

ghs.en: to the point where even breathing could stop.

rows.jp: 甘いにおい。
rows.en: A sweet scent.

ghs.en: A sweet scent.

rows.jp: 香水でも石けんのものでもない。
rows.en: Neither perfume nor soap.

ghs.en: It is neither perfume nor soap.

rows.jp: 少女自身の体臭。
rows.en: The girl's own bodily scent.

ghs.en: Just the smell of her own body.

rows.jp: 青臭い吐き気をもよおすような獣臭の下から、すべてを打ち消しつつ立ちのぼる。
rows.en: It rises through the raw, nauseating animal reek underneath, overwhelming everything else.

ghs.en: It rises from beneath a beastly smell so nauseatingly grassy, denying and canceling it all.

rows.jp: 柔らかな花弁に似た唇が、優しい声を押し出す。
rows.en: Lips like soft petals release a gentle voice.

ghs.en: Her lips like petals, soft, extrude a gentle voice.

rows.jp: 「毎日、つらい？」
rows.en: “Is every day painful?”

ghs.en: Girl: "Everyday, painful?"

rows.jp: 少し考えて、正直に答えた。
rows.en: I think for a moment, then answer honestly.

ghs.en: I thought a little, then answered honestly.

rows.jp: 「うん」
rows.en: “Yeah.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yes."

rows.jp: 「痛い？」
rows.en: “Does it hurt?”

ghs.en: Girl: "Hurts?"

rows.jp: 「痛いよ」
rows.en: “It hurts.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "It hurts!"

rows.jp: 「誰も助けてはくれない？」
rows.en: “No one will help you?”

ghs.en: Girl: "No one coming to rescue you?"

rows.jp: 「うん。優しい人、もういないからね」
rows.en: “No. There aren't any kind people left.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "No. There's no more of the nice people.

rows.jp: 「違う。昔からいなかったの」
rows.en: “No. There never were.”

ghs.en: Girl: "Wrong. There were none from the start."

rows.jp: 一転して、冷たく彼女は言った。
rows.en: Her voice turned cold in an instant.

ghs.en: She said that coldly, in a complete reversal.

rows.jp: 憎しみも敵意もない。
rows.en: No hatred or hostility.

ghs.en: With no hostility nor even hatred.

rows.jp: ただ冷たいだけ。
rows.en: Only coldness.

ghs.en: Exclusively and only with coldness.

rows.jp: 「でも昔の旦那様たちは」
rows.en: “But our old masters...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But the old masters..."

rows.jp: 「あれらは、弱いだけのものよ」
rows.en: “They were merely weak.”

ghs.en: Girl: "Those people were merely weak."
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: 「狭い心に余裕があれば、親切に見える時もある」
rows.en: “When their narrow hearts had room to spare, they could sometimes look kind.”

ghs.en: Girl: "If they had room in their cramped hearts, then there were times when they would look on kindly."

rows.jp: 「けど自分が苦しくなるとすぐに逃げ出す」
rows.en: “But the moment they suffered, they ran away.”

ghs.en: Girl: "But as soon as it got painful for themselves, they ran away."

rows.jp: 「……大切な玩具だって置き去り」
rows.en: “...Leaving even their precious toys behind.”

ghs.en: Girl: "...leaving behind even their precious toys."

rows.jp: 両手がぼくの肩に置かれる。
rows.en: Both her hands settle upon my shoulders.

ghs.en: Both her hands were placed on my shoulders,

rows.jp: つよく、つかむ。
rows.en: They grip hard.

ghs.en: and grip. With strength.

rows.jp: 「味方はいない。誰も助けない。自分のことを自分で守らないといけない」
rows.en: “We have no allies. No one will help us. We have to protect ourselves.”

ghs.en: Girl: "There are no allies. No one will rescue you. Protecting yourself by yourself is the only way."
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: そうだ。
rows.en: Yes.

ghs.en: True.

rows.jp: 悲しいけど。
rows.en: Sad as it was.

ghs.en: But sad.

rows.jp: それが真実ってやつだ。
rows.en: That was the truth of it.

ghs.en: That is what reality is.

rows.jp: 弱い子供は、餌食になる。
rows.en: Weak children become prey.

ghs.en: Weak children become prey.

rows.jp: 信じられないほど黒い欲望が、世の中にはある。
rows.en: There are desires in this world darker than anyone could imagine.

ghs.en: Dark desires to extents unbelievable exist in the heart of this world.

rows.jp: 僕も彼女も、それを知っている。
rows.en: She and I both know that.

ghs.en: Both the young boy that I am and the girl that she is know that.

rows.jp: 力もないぼくらは、知恵で自分を守るしかない。
rows.en: Without strength, we can protect ourselves only through cunning.

ghs.en: We have no strength, the two of us, and therefore must defend ourselves with wisdom.

rows.jp: 法律上『彼ら』こそがぼくたちの保護者なのだから。
rows.en: Because in the eyes of the law, ‘they’ are our guardians.

ghs.en: Because, as far as the law is concerned, "they" are our guardians.

rows.jp: けれどその保護者が、加害者であったなら？%N逆らえない。
rows.en: But what if those guardians are the ones harming us?%NWe cannot resist.

rows.jp: 広い屋敷と敷地。
rows.en: The sprawling mansion and grounds.

ghs.en: The mansion and the grounds are so big.

rows.jp: 何をしようが、彼らの行いが外にもれることはない。
rows.en: No matter what they do, word of it will never escape beyond the estate.

ghs.en: Whatever is done there, there is no leaking their deeds to the outside.

rows.jp: ぼくたちは―――
rows.en: We are—

ghs.en: We are---

rows.jp: 奴隷、なのだ。
